inputs.text: [excited] kor… ih… thoh… SOR… us. [curious] In ancient Greek, "corytho" means helmet, like a warrior's. And "saurus" is lizard. [pauses] The helmet lizard.
[happily] Exactly. A big rounded crest, hollow on the inside. [warmly] He lived in North America, seventy-six million years ago.
[nervous] And were there dangers around there?
[serious] Yes. Gorgosaurus and Daspletosaurus, two cousins of T. rex, hunted in that area. [confident] So Corythosaurus never stayed alone.
